# Honeydew

Household tasks. Format: `- [ ] task @due(YYYY-MM-DD) @who(name) @every(interval)`
(@due/@who/@every all optional). Check off with x. The nightly run re-lists
completed @every tasks with the next date and surfaces due/overdue ones in the
morning digest.

## Tasks

- [ ] Example: change HVAC filter @every(3 months)

## Done (nightly run moves checked items here with the date)
